summary: Kazuyoshi Soma is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Meiji Yamada. In 1987, he held a lecturer post at Ryukoku University.
Keenan W. Cox works in Buddhist studies and Sinology. He earned his MA at McMaster University, attested in 2014, under the supervision of James A. Benn.

Kees W. Bolle (1927–2012) was an Indology and religious studies scholar who studied at Leiden University (~1949–1953). He served as a fellow at the Netherlands Institute for Advanced Study and Professor Emeritus of History at UCLA (both attested 2005).

Kei Kataoka (born 1969) is an Indology and philosophy scholar who earned his PhD from the University of Tokyo. He held posts at Wolfson College, Oxford, the University of Tokyo, and Kyushu University as an associate professor from around 2007.

Keiichi Miyamoto (born 1948) is an Indology and philosophy scholar. He studied at the University of Tokyo (~1968–1978) under Minoru Hara, and served as assistant professor (~1987–1998) and professor (~1998–2018) at Kokugakuin University.

Keiji Nishitani (1900–1990) was a philosopher and religious studies scholar. He studied at Kyoto University (~1921–1924) under Kitaro Nishida, and later held academic posts at Kyoto University (~1935–1963) and Otani University (~1965–1971).

Keiki Yabuki (1879–1939) was a Buddhist and religious studies scholar who studied at Tohoku Fukushi, Taisho, and Tokyo universities. He founded Miwa Gakuin and taught at Shukyo University, the University of Tokyo, and Taisho University as professor (~1926–1939).

Keikyo Nakamikado works in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. Nakamikado held posts as a research collaborator at Bukkyo University (attested 2003) and as a researcher at the Chion-in Institute of Jodo Sect Studies (attested 2015).
Keir Magalie Strickland specializes in Indology, archaeology, and history. Strickland completed a PhD at Durham University under the doctoral supervision of Robin Coningham (attested 2011).

Keishin Okamura (1931–2019) was a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Kyoto University (~1952–1960). He held posts at Kōchi University and Koyasan University, serving at the latter as assistant professor (attested 1970).

Keisho Tsukamoto (1929–2010) was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology who completed his doctoral studies at Tohoku University. He served as president of Hosen Gakuen College (~1993–1999) and held posts at Tohoku and Rissho universities.

Keith Dowman (born 1945) is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He pursued traditional studies under teachers including Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Chatral Sangye Dorje Rinpoche, and Dudjom Jigdral Yeshe Dorje.

Keiya Noguchi (born 1954) specializes in Buddhist studies and Indology, completing doctoral coursework at Kyoto University. He served as professor at Shuchiin University and as director of the Institute for Comprehensive Studies of Buddhism at Taisho University (attested 2017).

Keizaburō Mizuno (1932–2026) studied at the University of Tokyo (~1951–1957) in Japanese history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. He held posts at Tokyo National Museum (1958–1968), Tokyo University of the Arts (~1999), and Niigata Prefectural Museum of Modern Art (2000–2008).

Kelsey Alise Seymour works in Sinology and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD at the University of Pennsylvania under Victor H. Mair (attested 2018) and was a Visiting Predoctoral Fellow at the Max Planck Institute for the History of Science (2017–2018).

Kemu Jin (1912–2000) was an Indologist, linguist, and Sinologist. He held a post at Visva-Bharati University (1941–1945) and served as Professor of Sanskrit at Peking University from around 1948 to 2000.
Kendall Marchman specializes in Buddhist studies and Sinology. Marchman studied under Mario Poceski (attested 2009) and completed a PhD at the University of Florida in 2015.

Keng Ching specializes in Buddhist studies and philosophy, earning a PhD from Harvard University under Robert M. Gimello and Parimal G. Patil. He served as an associate professor at National Chengchi University (attested 2013–2019).

Kengo Harimoto is an Indologist who completed a PhD at the University of Pennsylvania under Wilhelm Halbfass in 1999. He held faculty and researcher posts at Mahidol University (attested 2020) and the University of Naples "L'Orientale" (attested 2021–2022).

Kenji Matsuo (born 1954) is a scholar of Japanese history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. He studied at the University of Tokyo (~1973–1984) and held a post at Yamagata University from around 1987 to 2020.
